    "Lack of advanced features for complex project tracking",
    "Initial setup can feel manual with tools added one by one",
    "Notifications can be overwhelming or hard to manage"

  "overall_experience": "This marketing manager likely found Basecamp straightforward for managing basic tasks and facilitating team communication within their 51-200 person apparel company. However, the limited features and manual initial setup for projects, especially with a short trial period, may have left them wanting more robust functionality for a growing marketing department. The experience was likely positive for simple collaboration but revealed limitations for more complex project needs."
